existing_derivations.title: QCD and the origin of hadron masses
existing_derivations.abstract: The proton mass arises primarily from QCD binding energy, not quark masses. The electron mass comes from Higgs mechanism.

z_squared_connection: Fundamental constant - potential dimensional/scaling connection to Z²
mathematical_path:
Set up renormalization group flow. Compute beta function. Find fixed points. Extract universal constants from flow behavior.

Z² CONNECTION: Possible dimensional connection. Look for where factors of π or geometric ratios appear. Z² = 32π/3 may relate to integration over spherical geometry.
required_assumptions: No new physics beyond SM at relevant scales
